description: This file defines the `ThreadSnapshot` class, which models a snapshot of a thread's state within a VM trace. It includes thread attributes, stack frames, mutexes, binder call information, and comparison logic.

classes.name: ThreadSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of a thread's state in a VM trace, including thread attributes, stack frames, mutexes, binder call info, and comparison logic.

methods.name: ThreadSnapshot
methods.description: Default constructor. Constructs an empty ThreadSnapshot.

methods.name: ThreadSnapshot
methods.description: Copy constructor. Creates a deep copy of another ThreadSnapshot.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of this ThreadSnapshot.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this thread with another based on thread IDs.

methods.name: isBinder
methods.description: Returns true if the thread has an active binder call, ingress or egress.
